test_title: PYST 13: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 9 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are marked as P, Q, R, S, T, U. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one showing 'T'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0285f5f624748971b2ce70526adfb7892401c64225580c1e595d0e47214a27b5.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

When 2 faces are common in the 2 dice, then the uncommon faces are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c4f61202f1bfc699f4fdf175a8d667357df173c514bb6697bb1264df80e74f0.png] 

Therefore, U will be opposite to T

Hence, the correct answer will be **option(1)**
